data.name: Damurah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘damirah’, which means a steadfast mountain. This name reflects the unwavering nature of a person who remains strong and unyielding in their beliefs and values, even in the face of adversity. In Islamic tradition, mountains are symbolic of stability, resilience, and strength.

In various Islamic cultures, arms and weapons are associated with defense and protection. The name Damurah could be perceived as someone who is a defender and protector in life. It can also be seen as representing a leader who remains strong and unyielding in their beliefs and values.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Damurah represents a person who remains steadfast in their faith and resilient in the face of trials and tribulations. In Islamic teachings, faith and strength in Allah (God) are essential virtues. The name Damurah embodies this notion and serves as a reminder to stay strong and steadfast in our beliefs and in our relationship with Allah, despite any challenges we may encounter in life.
